facts.fact: The Countdown to 2030 country team (University of Zambia and Ministry of Health) states that 99% of expected monthly facility reports (mean of antenatal care, delivery, immunisation and outpatient forms) were in DHIS2 in 2024, against 93% in 2019, with 99% of districts at 90% completeness or more; it gives no count or share of facilities entering their own reports and does not say where the data are keyed.

systems.tiers: health facilities reporting monthly on antenatal care, delivery, immunisation, outpatient and inpatient services; tiers not stated
